limitations: Scoped desktop-browser automation only; not physical-device, comprehensive accessibility, practitioner-effectiveness, WPdx-certification or water-safety acceptance.

severity filters use text labels and correct counts
default local JSON report omits input values and headers and exports all severities
values enter the exported report only after explicit local checkbox choice

file byte limit enforced before reading
repeated sample loads do not duplicate findings; Clear removes visible input, mappings, and results
native reload does not restore a completed review or opt-in export choice
